intro: Kuwait is a small, flat desert country at the head of the Gulf, with a large bay and several islands.

chapters.title: Desert and bay
text: Kuwait Bay cuts deep into the land. The desert is flat and gravelly, rising slightly to the west. Bubiyan is the largest island.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Kuwait is one of the hottest places on Earth: Mitribah recorded about 54 °C in 2016. Dust storms are common.

keyTerms.meaning: Part of the sea partly surrounded by land.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Kuwait's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
